hypotheses.rationale: The headset at the desk at 09:00 on day 0 and phone at desk at 09:12 on day 2 suggest a morning work/study routine. The phone on the sofa at 14:17 on day 0 and at the coffee table at 15:50 on day 1 indicates afternoon leisure. The coffee mug put away at 21:45 on day 1 and the fork/plate put away at 21:45 on day 2 suggest an evening cleanup routine. This pattern is consistent with a typical work-from-home or student routine.
